theorem lg_target (a b : ℕ) (h : a * b = 12) (ha : a > b) (hb : b > 2) : a = 4 := by
  have h1 : b = 3 ∨ b = 4 := by
    have h2 : b ≤ 12 := by
      rcases Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_left h with ⟨c, hc⟩
      rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left (Nat.pos_of_gt hb)]
      exact Nat.le_mul_div_left b 12
    have h3 : b < 4 := by
      apply Nat.lt_iff_add_pos.mp
      have h4 : b + 0 < 4 := by
        apply Nat.lt_add_right
        exact hb
      exact h4
    have h5 : b < 5 := by
      apply Nat.lt_iff_add_pos.mp
      have h6 : b + 1 < 5 := by
        apply Nat.lt_add_right
        exact h2
      exact h6
    cases h3 with h3 h3; cases h5 with h5 h5
    · exact Or.inl h3
    · exact Or.inr h5
  cases h1 with b_val b_val
  case left :=
    have h2 : a = 12 / b := by
      rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left (Nat.pos_of_gt hb)]
    have h3 : a = 4 := by
      rw [h2]
      exact Nat.div_eq_of_mul_eq h (Nat.eq_of_div_eq_right h2)
    exact h3
  case right :=
    have h2 : a = 12 / b := by
      rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left (Nat.pos_of_gt hb)]
    have h3 : a = 3 := by
      rw [h2]
      exact Nat.div_eq_of_mul_eq h (Nat.eq_of_div_eq_right h2)
    contradiction
